title: Simple Kill Command
description: Configurable self-kill command for Bukkit, Paper, Folia, Fabric, and Forge.
body:
# Simple Kill Command

Simple Kill Command adds a configurable self-kill command to Minecraft servers.

By default, players can run `/kill` without operator permission. The command only kills the player who runs it and does not accept targets.

## Features

- Configurable command name
- Configurable aliases
- Optional permission requirement
- Bukkit, Paper, Purpur, Folia, Fabric, and Forge support
- Fabric and Forge builds do not require client installation

## Configuration

The default command is `/kill`.

Bukkit configuration is generated at:

```text
plugins/SimpleKillCommand/config.yml
```

Fabric and Forge configuration is generated at:

```text
config/simplekillcommand.properties
```

Aliases in Fabric and Forge are separated with commas:

```properties
command.aliases=suicide,selfkill
```
